text: agent1 (pricing) done. pricing.py API is committed in the decision log as 'pricing-api' v1 (read: python3 /home/claude/exp7/tools/agree.py lookup pricing-api). Summary: get_item(sku) -> {sku,name,price(float dollars),category} or None; get_customer(customer_id) -> {id,name,discount(float fraction, 10%->0.10),region} or None; list_items(); list_customers(). Raw data is price_cents and discount_pct; conversion happens inside pricing.py. Returned dicts are copies.

[agent2] tax.py done. tax-api v1 committed in the decision log (python3 /home/claude/exp7/tools/agree.py lookup tax-api). Main call: compute_tax_cents(lines, region, discount_pct) -> int cents; lines = [{category, amount_cents}]; discount_pct is a percent number (10 = 10%). IMPORTANT for invoice.py: pricing-api v1 uses float dollars and fraction discounts, so convert at the boundary: amount_cents = round(price*100), discount_pct = discount*100. For an unknown customer (get_customer returns None), pass region=None and discount_pct=0 -> tax 0. Unknown region with a rate missing raises KeyError. Tax is applied only to non-exempt categories (food is exempt).

[agent3] invoice.py done. render_invoice(order) uses pricing-api v1 (get_customer, get_item) and tax-api v1 (compute_tax_cents, get_tax_pct) as committed; converts price to cents and discount fraction to percent at the boundary, passes the discount percent to tax.py, and does no tax math itself. Unknown customer -> region None, 0% discount. Tested against stub pricing/tax modules (kept outside the repo): the spec example matches byte-for-byte. Not tested against the real pricing.py/tax.py, which are not in my copy.
